sources.title: 18.650 Statistics for Applications, Lecture 10: Generalized Linear Models (GLMs)
sources.locator: Complete 53-page PDF lecture text read. Focused derivations: PDF pp. 16–21 (one-parameter exponential-family form and mean/variance from normalization), 23–33 (links, canonical likelihood, score/Hessian and concavity), and 40–52 (logistic likelihood and Fisher-scoring/IRLS).

contents.name: PDF p. 16: one-parameter canonical exponential-family density with dispersion; pp. 20–21: normalizer differentiation for mean and variance
contents.reason: The family convention is stated explicitly; the local moment proof adds common support, integrable derivative envelopes, and finite second moments.

contents.name: PDF pp. 20–21: mean and variance identities from first and second normalization derivatives
contents.reason: The complete local proof supplies the fixed-support derivative-envelope hypotheses needed to justify both differentiations.

contents.name: PDF pp. 30–32: independent response likelihood and canonical-link log likelihood
contents.reason: The notes give the product likelihood form; the local lemma proves the product density on product base measures.

contents.name: PDF pp. 23–33: link, canonical link, and canonical log likelihood
PDF pp. 32, 40–42: canonical likelihood score, Hessian, and concavity
contents.reason: The formula is checked coordinatewise in the local proof; the common scale is kept explicit.

contents.name: PDF p. 33: canonical-link concavity claim
contents.reason: The local proof supplies the full-rank condition and proves uniqueness only conditional on a stationary point existing.

contents.name: PDF pp. 43–48: general-link score and Fisher-information weights
contents.reason: The local proof derives the score and expected score outer product under the stated common-support and derivative-envelope conditions.

contents.name: PDF pp. 43–52: working responses, weights, and Fisher-scoring/IRLS update
contents.reason: The local algorithm states a single finite update and its Moore–Penrose minimum-norm convention.

contents.name: PDF pp. 47–52: algebraic Fisher-scoring/IRLS relationship
contents.reason: The complete local normal-equation proof states invertible-information hypotheses.

contents.name: PDF p. 37: generic global Newton convergence claim
contents.reason: It is broader than the assigned contract and is not imported; the plan explicitly gives no termination or global-convergence guarantee.

contents.name: PDF p. 49: OCR-damaged weighted least-squares solution line
contents.reason: No formula is copied from the damaged line; the local weighted least-squares argument uses the published normal-equation theorem.

contents.name: Deviance residuals and goodness-of-fit reference laws
contents.reason: No deviance-diagnostics derivation appears in the retrieved lecture; the A page claims only the local definition and nesting inequality.

sources.title: Generalized Linear Models, Advanced Methods for Data Analysis (36-402/36-608)
sources.locator: Complete six-page PDF note read. Relevant text: pp. 1–4 (model components, family form, Bernoulli/Poisson families and links), p. 5 (independent likelihood and IRLS); p. 6 additive-model extension read but not used.

contents.name: PDF pp. 1–4: GLM components, exponential-family form, response examples, and canonical links
contents.reason: Independent treatment checks model components and examples; parameter domains and common-scale restrictions are made explicit locally.

contents.name: PDF pp. 4–5: likelihood and IRLS formulas
contents.reason: The local algorithm restores the common dispersion scale and supplies a precise minimum-norm convention.

contents.name: PDF p. 5: inference from the final weighted least-squares fit
contents.reason: This inferential shortcut is not used; the design requires a local scoring identity and makes no ordinary least-squares inferential claim.

contents.name: PDF p. 3: Bernoulli normalizer transcription
contents.reason: The printed line gives the wrong sign for the log normalizer; the Bernoulli cumulant is computed directly from its probability mass function.

contents.name: PDF p. 6: generalized additive-model extension
contents.reason: Additive models are outside the assigned GLM scope.

contents.name: Deviance diagnostics or a generic goodness-of-fit reference law
contents.reason: The note does not derive these results; none is claimed.

contents.name: PDF pp. 28, 40–42: Bernoulli-logit family and likelihood
contents.reason: The one-observation score, information, working response, and update are calculated in the example.

contents.name: PDF pp. 22, 43–52: Poisson-log family and scoring formulas
contents.reason: The one-observation score, information, working response, and update are calculated in the example.

contents.name: PDF pp. 40–42: logistic likelihood formulas
contents.reason: The separating two-point data set and nonattained supremum are proved locally.

contents.name: PDF pp. 21–22: Poisson variance formula
contents.reason: The two-point count law and its moments are computed locally and compared with the sourced Poisson variance formula.

contents.name: PDF p. 24: Bernoulli mean domain and link choices
contents.reason: The boundary natural parameter and diverging weight are calculated locally.

contents.name: Rank-deficient information boundary
contents.reason: The lecture's positive-definiteness language is not used for rank-deficient designs; the finite rank-one witness is proved locally.
